comparison: Gaussian remains6/72 stationary and2/24 shifted-hold passes, with exact saved sample/model/optimizer states on the target failures. Grid first observed divergence occurs at4750, improving holdout precision .30497 to .35668 but worsening covariance trace bias .32543 to .46348 and retaining the complete FAIL. Passing same-law saved panels expose a residual floor above tau .020; no per-update applied-movement history was retained.
conclusion: 4/15 PASS, all eleven original failures retained and all four regression controls retained. Relocating existing thermal scaling does not repair Gaussian or overlap settling. Fourteen final metric dictionaries exactly match the control; dense grid changes but still fails.

Retain saved-state and analytical negative controls: an unchanged energy-U observer would cool missing rare/ring populations prematurely while its peak EMA reheats passing overlap panels. Require a support-sensitive and noise-aware signal to pass those controls before a separately preregistered successor; no threshold sweep or additional paid round.
